items.followUp: What is the purpose of the network layer in the OSI model?

rubric.why: The transport layer provides communication from the sending end.
rubric.description: Identifies the source end of communication.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that the layer supports end-to-end communication from the source.

rubric.why: The transport layer delivers data to the destination process and may provide reliable delivery.
rubric.description: Identifies delivery to the destination or a key transport function.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for mentioning the destination process, reliable delivery, or segmentation.

modelAnswer: The transport layer provides end-to-end delivery of data from the source to the destination process.
It can divide data into segments and provide reliable delivery.
